_comment: Non-sensitive defaults only. Database credentials are resolved at runtime from FISHMMO_DB_USERNAME / FISHMMO_DB_PASSWORD or /etc/fishmmo/db-secrets.env — never from this file. Non-credential Npgsql settings come from appsettings.Database.json conventions; override here only if this host differs.
_comment_allowed_hosts: Restricted to localhost for development. Set to the panel hostname (e.g. "panel.fishmmo.com") in production — a wildcard "*" allows any host and is a security risk.
_comment_cors: The Control Panel serves its own single-page app from the same origin, so no cross-origin access is needed. Leave empty to deny.
_comment_connection_strings: ConnectionStrings:NpgsqlConnection is read only by the Production SSL-mode guard. Supply it via the ConnectionStrings__NpgsqlConnection environment variable.
